alignments.note: The preposition before the infinitive construct takes the written *To*, rule 52.
Preposition takes the word written for it.
Suffix rendered by the object pronoun, rule 18.
No article morpheme stands on the noun, so the supplied determiner belongs to the nominal expression under rule 15 and the head stays on the word carrying the lexeme.
Predicate noun keeps its own word; the copula the clause would otherwise supply is what the possessive recasting has replaced, and rule 43 places that word on the preposition.
The independent pronoun is realized by the demonstrative determiner; the referent's own noun stands written in the clause, so the pronoun takes only that determiner under rule 18.

The clause is verbless with no existential particle, so the possessive preposition is what makes it possessive and carries the English *have*, rule 43. The margin's 'Or, He is the honor of all his saints' would have kept the clause copular; it was read and set aside, the printed text governing by rule 38.
Quantifier keeps only the word written for it.
Substantival adjective; the phrase's determiner is the written possessive, so no noun phrase need be supplied for it.
Suffix rendered by the possessive, rule 18. MACULA's gloss distributes this word's sense across the segments in reverse; the morphology is what is read, by rule 39.
Imperative with its supplied English subject pronoun under rule 17, headed on the lexical verb.
The ASV renders the short name by the full divine name; the margin's 'Hebrew Hallelujah' is a literal gloss and decides nothing, by rule 38.

review_notes: *have* is placed on the possessive `לְ` under rule 43, no `הָיָה` and no existential particle standing in the clause; the demonstrative *This* is the written `הוּא`'s under rule 18, the noun `הָדָר` being written beside it.
The margin's alternative rendering of the second colon was read and set aside; it licenses no target token.
